options.name: address
options.description: The private IP Address where this backend can be reached. This must be a private IP address.

options.name: config_id
options.description: The ID of the NodeBalancer Config that contains this node.

options.name: label
options.description: The label for this node. This is used to identify nodes within a config.

options.name: mode
options.description: The mode this NodeBalancer should use when sending traffic to this backend.

options.name: nodebalancer_id
options.description: The ID of the NodeBalancer that contains this node.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the NodeBalancer node should be present or absent.

options.name: weight
options.description: Nodes with a higher weight will receive more traffic.
